COT Historical Special Announcements

2025

December 9, 2025: The processing and publication of Commitments of Traders data were interrupted from October 1 – November 12 due to a lapse in federal appropriations. Following a return to normal operations, the CFTC resumed publication of the Commitments of Traders reports in chronological order. The release schedule depicts the intended COT Report publication dates for the data associated with the original publication date.

January 07, 2025: Due to the National Day of Mourning for the passing of former President James Earl Carter Jr., CFTC offices will be closed on Thursday, January 9, 2025. This week’s Commitments of Traders Report will be released on Monday, January 13, 2025.

2024

November 13, 2024: As previously announced by MGEX October 3, 2024 Alert, Minneapolis Grain Exchange (MGEX) was renamed MIAX Futures Exchange (MIAX Futures). Therefore, weekly Commitments reports for the WHEAT-HRSpring would change to indicate MIAX rather than MGEX.

2023

May 5, 2023: The respective Consolidated Reports combine their associated e-micro contracts S&P 500 (13874+), Nasdaq100 (20974+), DJIA (12460+)

March 21, 2023: The cyber-related incident at ION prevented the submission of timely and accurate data to the CFTC last month. As a result, the weekly CFTC Commitments of Traders (CoT) report had been delayed. Today, staff is issuing the Commitments of Traders report that was originally scheduled to be published on March 17, 2023. 

March 17, 2023: The cyber-related incident at ION prevented the submission of timely and accurate data to the CFTC last month. As a result, the weekly CFTC Commitments of Traders (CoT) report has been delayed. Today, staff will not issue the Commitments of Traders report as data for this week will need to be reviewed and validated.

The CFTC intends to sequentially issue the missed COT reports, subject to reporting firms submitting accurate and complete data.

March 16, 2023: The cyber-related incident at ION prevented the submission of timely and accurate data to the CFTC last month. As a result, the weekly CFTC Commitments of Traders (CoT) report had been delayed. Today, staff is issuing the Commitments of Traders report that was originally scheduled to be published on March 10, 2023.

March 14, 2023: The cyber-related incident at ION prevented the submission of timely and accurate data to the CFTC last month. As a result, the weekly CFTC Commitments of Traders (CoT) report had been delayed. Today, staff is issuing the Commitments of Traders report that was originally scheduled to be published on March 03, 2023. 

March 10, 2023: The cyber-related incident at ION prevented the submission of timely and accurate data to the CFTC last month. As a result, the weekly CFTC Commitments of Traders (CoT) report had been delayed. Today, staff is issuing the Commitments of Traders report that was originally scheduled to be published on February 24, 2023.  Staff has adjusted today’s CoT report to account for reporting discrepancies, specifically, open interest in the IFED PJM Western Hub Day-Ahead Peak, IFED MISO Indiana Real-Time Off-Peak Fixed Price, IFED MISO Indiana Hub Day-Ahead Peak, IFED Fuel Oil Crack-Marine Fuel 0.5% FOB USGC Barges (Platts) vs Brent Crude 1st Line, and IFED Condensate Diff-TMX C5 1A Index contract markets have been modified to provide the best estimate of positions for the report dated February 21, 2023.

March 8, 2023: The cyber-related incident at ION prevented the submission of timely and accurate data to the CFTC last month. As a result, the weekly CFTC Commitments of Traders (CoT) report had been delayed. Today, staff is issuing the Commitments of Traders report that was originally scheduled to be published on February 17, 2023. Staff has adjusted today’s CoT report to account for reporting discrepancies, specifically, open interest in the CME 1 Month SOFR, CME S&P 500 Annual Dividend Index, IFED PJM Western Hub Day-Ahead Peak, IFED PJM Western Hub Real-Time Off-Peak Fixed Price, IFED MISO Indiana Real-Time Off-Peak Fixed Price, IFED MISO Indiana Hub Day-Ahead Peak, IFED Palo Verde Day-Ahead Off-Peak Fixed Price, and IFED Condensate Diff-TMX C5 1A Index contract markets have been modified to provide the best estimate of positions for the report dated February 14, 2023.

March 3, 2023: The cyber-related incident at ION prevented the submission of timely and accurate data to the CFTC last month. As a result, the weekly CFTC Commitments of Traders (CoT) report had been delayed. Today, staff is issuing the Commitments of Traders report that was originally scheduled to be published on February 10, 2023. Staff has adjusted today’s CoT report to account for reporting discrepancies, specifically, open interest in the CME 3 Month SOFR, IFED Mid-Columbia Day-Ahead Peak, and IFED PJM Western Hub Real-Time Off-Peak Fixed Price contract markets have been modified to provide the best estimate of positions for the report dated February 7, 2023.

February 24, 2023: The cyber-related incident at ION prevented the submission of timely and accurate data to the CFTC. As a result, the weekly CFTC Commitments of Traders (CoT) report had been delayed. Today, staff is issuing the Commitments of Traders report that was originally scheduled to be published on February 3, 2023. Staff will issue Commitments of Traders reports on an expedited basis going forward and continues to expect that publication of backlogged reports will be complete by mid-March. In addition, staff has adjusted today’s CoT report to account for reporting discrepancies resulting from the cyber-related incident at ION. Specifically, open interest in the IFED MISO IN RT Off-Peak and CME USD Malaysian Crude Palm Oil Calendar Spread contract markets has been modified to provide the best estimate of positions for the week ending January 31, 2023. In addition, open interest in the Dow Jones U.S. Real Estate Index appears to have been impacted for report dated January 31, 2023 as a result of the ION incident; however, the reportable position data has been confirmed to be accurate.

February 16, 2023: Following the ION cyber-related incident, reporting firms are continuing to experience some issues submitting timely and accurate data to the CFTC. As a result, the weekly Commitments of Traders (CoT) report will be postponed. CFTC staff intends to resume publishing the CoT report as early as Friday, February 24, 2023.

  • Press Release: CFTC Announces Postponement of Commitments of Traders Report

February 10, 2023: The impact of the cyber-related incident at ION is being mitigated. However, multiple reporting firms continue to experience technical issues that prevent submission of timely and accurate data to the CFTC. As a result, the weekly CFTC Commitments of Traders report will continue to be delayed until the receipt and validation of all reportable data is completed.

  • Press Release: CFTC Issues Statement on the Ongoing Impact to Reporting

February 2, 2023: An ongoing issue with a third-party service provider is impacting some reporting firms’ ability to provide the Commission with timely and accurate data. As a result, the Commitments of Traders report for publication date February 3, 2023, will be delayed. A report will be published upon receipt and validation of data from those firms.

  • CFTC Statement on ION and the Impact to the Derivatives Markets
2022

February 11, 2022: The reports this week will have shorter names for some contract markets, which allows CFTC to streamline and enhance our reporting capabilities. The contract market codes and other data elements are unaffected. This is a list of the changing names, in alphabetical order of the old name.

2021

June 17, 2021: Due to the observance of a new federal holiday on Friday, June 18th, the COT report, with data from Tuesday June 15th, due to be published on Friday June 18, 2021 will instead be published on Monday June 21, 2021.

2020

December 28, 2020: Due to the additional federal holiday on December 24th, we published data dated Monday December 21, 2020 on Monday December 28, 2020.

May 29, 2020: Due to timing differences that may arise on rare occasions in open interest calculations between the exchanges and various reporting firms on the last trading day, data for the June 2020 Natural Gas Penultimate ICE contract (CFTC ID 023392) for May 26, 2020 (last trading date) has been omitted from this report.

2019
